notes.title: TALES FROM CENTROPOLIS is live on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce our 'Tales from Centropolis' Kickstarter campaign is now LIVE!

Our team has been working tirelessly to bring this project to life, and we need your support on Kickstarter to help make it happen. We have a number of exciting rewards available for our backers, including early access to the game, exclusive in-game content, and even the opportunity to have a character named after you in the game.

Join us on this exciting journey and help us bring 'Tales from Centropolis' to life as a video game. Thank you for your support!

Now's your chance to make an impact.
